title: End of content!
description:
You've reached the end of 'intentional' content for the sake of the Big Autumn Packjam. Thank you for playing!

There's nothing stopping you from playing more, I just haven't put a ton of effort into the content going forward.

This modpack was made in 2 weeks! If you want me to keep making it, please let me know in the discord! Feedback and suggestions are always welcome.
